summary:
FMLink reports that ISSA-The Association for Cleaning & Facility Solutions has released its 2026 State Pesticide Registration Survey to ISSA members. The resource compiles pesticide registration requirements for every U.S. state plus Washington, DC, Puerto Rico, the Virgin Islands and Guam. New for 2026 is an interactive map feature intended to help members find the requirements most relevant to their companies more quickly.

The piece frames pesticide registration as a critical compliance area for the cleaning and facility solutions industry because many cleaning products fall under that regulatory category. Understanding state-specific rules is presented as essential for compliance and for avoiding costly penalties. The survey covers fees, renewal deadlines, penalties, and contact information for state regulatory agencies.

Updates since the 2025 edition: registration fees have increased in Illinois, Nebraska, New Mexico and Oregon, and ISSA expects Delaware fees to rise soon. Registration authority references have also been updated throughout the 2026 survey.

ISSA encourages relevant members to use the resource and to give feedback on its usefulness, and directs questions to ISSA Senior Government Affairs Manager Stacy Seiden. The item is a short association resource announcement aimed at facilities and cleaning industry compliance audiences, with no data on workplace occupancy, hybrid work, or workplace technology.
